title: The Pink Heart New Year Fridge Reset
description: A pink New Year fridge organization reset from Amazon: a pink heart shelf liner, pink produce containers with colanders, a pink DYMO label maker, rolling egg holders and pink magnetic fridge shelves.
intro: Every January 1st I open the fridge and find a lone cranberry sauce from Thanksgiving and three half-empty ranches. Every year I say I'll fix it. This year I actually did, and I made it cute, because if I'm going to spend New Year's Day scrubbing shelves, it's going to be pink. Heart liners on every shelf, berries in little pink baskets, eggs that roll themselves forward, and a label maker. Yes, I labeled the lemons. No regrets.

sections.heading: The inside
paragraphs: Pink heart shelf liner on every shelf, a 12 in wide roll that you cut to size and wipe clean, no sticky mess. The set of 4 pink produce containers has colander baskets and airtight lids, so berries stop turning to mush by Tuesday. The 3 clear rolling egg trays stack up and the eggs roll to the front on their own, which is weirdly satisfying.

sections.heading: The outside
paragraphs: Two pink magnetic wire shelves stick right on the side of the fridge (12.2 in wide each) for lemons, onions, potatoes, whatever's crowding the counter. No drilling, which my landlord appreciates.

sections.heading: The bossy part
paragraphs: The pink DYMO LetraTag label maker. Berries, eggs, leftovers, "do not eat, this is for the party." Labels make it look like I have my life together. I mostly do.

sections.heading: Shop it
paragraphs: Every piece is linked below, and every look I make lives on my Amazon storefront: https://www.amazon.com/shop/thedigitalincomeedit
